regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, and SI availability line
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate regio-/stereoselective borylcupration claim. The article mentions online SI, but workspace association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Known allene borylcupration through allylic copper intermediates is explicitly background cited to references 1–4 and is classified as a literature example, not a current experiment.

The current generic allenylsilane pathway is classified as a general scheme: (E)-2M leads to (Z)-2, while (Z)-2M, (E)-2, products 3, and 4 are shown or stated not formed. Experiment-specific values are assigned to Tables 1–3 instead.
The prose maps to all nine Table 1 rows: entries 1–6 give low-yield 4m and recovered 1m; entry 7 gives both 4m and (Z)-2m; entries 8–9 give selective (Z)-2m. No narrative duplicates were created.
The R-dependent scope discussion introduces the twelve Table 2 experiments, including separable 4d/4e regioisomers and tolerated alkene/TBS ether groups. Row conditions/outcomes are linked to page 2.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 groups and intermediates do not define unique structures or experiment-level quantities.
SI association remains unestablished; no SI conditions were inferred.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–9, ligand drawings, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Nine independent optimization runs were retained with exact common scale, CuCl/NaOtBu/B2(pin)2/iPrOH, row ligand/loading, THF or entry-9 Et2O, RT/time, product-specific NMR yields or not-detected values, starting-material recoveries, and crude-1H-NMR selectivity. Dashes remain source markers.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 2 header, entries 1–12, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve distinct TMS-allenylsilane scope experiments were retained with shared exact amounts/Et2O volume, row times, isolated yields, and product-targeted 96:4/92:8 ratios for entries 4/5. Entry 1 is linked to the detailed page-3 paragraph.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right scope prose and Scheme-2 introduction
regions.finding: The prose introduces eleven Table 3 experiments plus three Scheme 2 controls. The one-gram entry remains separate from the ordinary 1m row, and aryl-row base/B2(pin)2 overrides are row-specific.

regions.region: page 2 center-right Table 3 header, entries 1–11, and footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven distinct silyl/R scope or scale experiments were retained with times, isolated yields, standard conditions, the entry-2 one-gram-scale statement, and entry-8–11 NaOtBu/B2(pin)2 overrides.
The ORTEP image characterizes existing Table 3 entry 4 product (Z)-2o; it is not a second preparation and does not verify a machine structure encoding.

unresolved: Table 3 entry 2 says one-gram scale without an exact participant mass/mmol assignment.
Table 2 entries 4/5 do not state the analytical basis for their regioisomer ratios.
Operational workup and isolated masses are absent except for the detailed 2a experiment on page 3.

regions.finding: Three distinct controls were retained: 1w→(Z)-2w (13 h, 91%), 1x→2x (9 h, 95%, E/Z 73:27, 1.5 equiv B2(pin)2), and 1y→4y (1 h, 75%).

regions.region: page 3 center-left Scheme 3 and adjacent prose
regions.finding: The iPrOD experiment is one reported reaction giving [D]-(Z)-2m in 87% with 57% vinylic D incorporation. Proposed intermediates A/B/C are represented separately as a mechanism and not as isolated experiments.

One ordered two-step sequence was retained: RT borylcupration for 1 h, filtration, then DMAP/NBS in DCM at 0 °C for 1 h, giving product 5 in 79% combined yield. The overall value was not assigned to the last step alone.

The detailed 1a→(Z)-2a procedure enriches Table 2 entry 1 with exact masses/mmol, two Et2O carrier volumes, sequential charging under argon, RT/40 min, TLC, silica filtration/elution, chromatography, 249.3 mg, and 84% isolated yield. Visual inspection resolves iPrOH as 153 uL, not the text-layer mL OCR error.

regions.region: page 3 acknowledgments and beginning of references
regions.finding: Reproduction of (Z)-2i and (Z)-2q is provenance for existing Table 2 entry 9/Table 3 entry 6 because no independent run details are given. Bibliography is prior-literature context.

unresolved: Scheme 2/3 omit absolute scales, most operational details, product masses, and several analytical bases.
Equation (1) does not state scale, solvent volumes, atmosphere, final workup, isolated mass, or whether 79% is isolated.
The isotope-resolved product remains label-only and machine-unverified.
